authority: National Remote Sensing Centre, ISRO, under the National Hydrology Project
notes: Official NRSC/NHP material verifies operational hydrological drought products including SRI, SRSI and SWSI, while some groundwater/composite products have narrower documented spatial scope. JLA has not admitted an exact Jharkhand payload. Before curation it requires exact product/service identity, immutable bytes or governed service snapshot, SHA-256, rights/attribution review, observed schema and metadata, accumulation/assessment period, units/index definition, thresholds, spatial resolution, uncertainty/latency information when available, and evidence-backed geographic linkage. Do not infer Jharkhand coverage for a product whose documented scope is narrower.

authority: National Remote Sensing Centre, ISRO / Mahalanobis National Crop Forecast Centre, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare
notes: Official NRSC material verifies NADAMS agricultural drought monitoring and identifies Jharkhand among monitored drought-prone states. No exact Jharkhand assessment payload has been acquired or hashed. Future curation must preserve assessment date/season, drought-management methodology/version, rainfall and vegetation/moisture inputs, category definitions, administrative unit and geography vintage. NADAMS agricultural drought classes must not be relabelled as meteorological or hydrological drought.

authority: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences, Government of India
notes: IMD is verified as the authoritative national meteorological service and an official discovery route for meteorological drought-related products and reports, but JLA has not acquired an exact reusable Jharkhand drought-index payload. Any SPI, SPEI, aridity-anomaly or related value must retain the exact source product, accumulation window, baseline/reference period, threshold/category definition, units where applicable, assessment date, spatial support and geography vintage. Narrative documentation alone is not a publishable numeric dataset.

authority: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
notes: LGD is an already governed shared Core Geography dependency used only for evidence-backed current administrative linkage. It is not a Drought & Water Stress thematic observation. Current LGD geography must never be treated as equivalent to Census 2011 or a historical drought-assessment geography from names alone; cross-vintage linkage requires explicit evidence.
